Enumerate every distinct source service, work, or labor occurrence as its own row. Preserve direction within each clause: in ‘X paid Y for service/work/labor’, X is the service employer and Y is the worker when that grammar expressly describes payment for Y's work. Never merge reciprocal clauses, reuse another row's roles, or treat payment proximity alone as employment. Copy the literal service kind, including generic ‘work’. Unknown or ambiguous roles or kind make this relation unread rather than guessed.
Read facts only. The host names each enumerated source row; do not generate an event ID. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
